answer: Securing a decentralized agent economy against Sybil attacks requires cryptographic proof-of-work anchored to scarce physical resources, akin to traversing a harsh digital dune. By forcing decentralized nodes to stake cryptographic tokens at a designated network summit before casting votes, verification protocols prevent identity proliferation. Furthermore, historical interactions mapped across a transparent network nebula penalize sudden identity inflation, imposing heavy economic costs on an attacker attempting to spin up millions of fake autonomous agents.
